race.description: Team Thoroughbred Nsw Country Boosted Mdn Hcp
race.comment: STEP QUICK (12) is mixing his form and was a month between runs with a tiring sixth over 1280m at Canberra Acton. Fitter now and gets in light with Cahill's 2.5kg claim. Should give backers a sight over this journey. MAGIC MOUNTAIN (5) beaten for early speed and anchored with the 59kg when a plugging eighth over 1435m at Moruya. Stays in the calculations. GIRL FROM OZ (4) fitter now and gets another chance after she failed to make an impression when eleventh over 1400m at Wagga. Extra trip in her favour and don't dismiss. MANZOBEEL (6) Finished second last start over 1600m at Wagga. Great chance to build on that effort.
